scope: Complete saved490-frame DR/DR+VN/WRN node matrices and245-bin amplitude spectra, fixed component order; output precision check only
formula: Float64 temporal demean per component; abs FFT; first245 bins (DC through bin244). One complete subject, no Welch, tail normalization, component permutation or sign fitting.
text_precision: Original MSMregression dlmwrite has default five significant digits for both node and spectral text; FNIT stores nodes with17 significant digits. Native-text FFT comparison records rounding/quantization effects.
output_boundary: Spectra derived here from saved full FNIT nodes for validation; not an implemented production spectral-output API. No original FFT/graphics wall-time speed ratio.
privacy: Aggregate numerical errors/source hashes only; no node arrays, spectra arrays, brain maps or private paths saved
